scope_note: Vietnam national daytime pilot; no diocesan overlay. Listed decisions are source-backed; all other dates use the owner-approved General Roman baseline. No Gospel mapping is approved here.

decisions.note: Hà Nội and Vĩnh Long both keep Epiphany on Sunday January 4, 2026. No 2026 national directive naming the date was captured.

decisions.celebration: Mồng Hai Tết – Kính nhớ tổ tiên và ông bà cha mẹ
decisions.note: National directive item 1 assigns this Mass. Lent and Ash Wednesday Hours still begin on February 18; do not transfer the season.

decisions.celebration: Mồng Ba Tết – Thánh hóa công ăn việc làm
decisions.note: National directive item 2 assigns this Mass, not the ordinary Thursday-after-Ash Mass.
National directive item 3 assigns the Ash Mass and ashes, fasting and abstinence. This does not move the beginning of Lent or the Hours.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Easter on April 5. Default daytime only; no Easter Vigil or evening variant is selected.

Owner chose the Sunday schedule on 2026-11-11. The national proclamation lists both schedules; Vĩnh Long and Phan Thiết keep Sunday May 17, Hà Nội keeps Thursday May 14. May 14 therefore follows the baseline.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Pentecost on May 24. Default daytime only, not the vigil.

decisions.celebration: Mình và Máu Thánh Chúa Kitô
decisions.note: The national 2026 proclamation names Corpus Christi on June 7; the baseline's Sunday transfer agrees. No all-years transfer law is claimed from this template alone.
National directive section II.2 requires All Saints on November 1, superseding Ordinary Sunday 31. October 31 evening is outside the implemented daytime option.

Owner chose the Sunday Mass on 2026-11-11. Hà Nội keeps Sunday XXXIII and permits the Vietnamese Martyrs celebration by pastoral need (citing HĐGMVN 4-1991); Vĩnh Long lists both. The Martyrs Mass stays a legitimate alternative, not selected.

decisions.celebration: Đức Giêsu Kitô Vua Vũ Trụ
decisions.note: The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Christ the King on November 22.

decisions.celebration: Các Thánh Tử Đạo Việt Nam
decisions.note: Hà Nội prints rank Trọng and Vĩnh Long Lễ trọng (CD 878/90) for November 24. The decree itself was not obtained. The pinned Vietnam plugin's November 13 placement stays rejected.
The national 2026 proclamation explicitly names Advent I on November 29. Its new Sunday cycle must come from that date, not the civil year's earlier Sundays.

unsupported.2026-02-17: Tết day 1: Hà Nội assigns the New Year Mass, Vĩnh Long keeps the weekday and only permits it; no 2026 national directive captured
unsupported.2026-10-04: Sunday XXVII: Hà Nội adds a Rosary external solemnity; national applicability not reviewed
unsupported.2026-10-18: Mission Sunday: Hà Nội lists the Mission Mass on Sunday XXIX; national default not reviewed

baseline.note: General Roman baseline (owner-approved 2026-11-11) for a date with no known Vietnamese rule; computed by the pinned beta provider, not a national directive.

diocesan_evidence_rule.note: Owner accepts agreeing official diocesan calendars as evidence of national practice when no HĐGMVN directive is captured. They remain diocesan publications.

ascension-sunday.choice: Ascension on Sunday for a site with no diocesan overlay

martyrs-sunday-33.choice: Show Sunday XXXIII, not the optional Martyrs celebration
